objects: one resolving fixed positive Amass instruction
current phased-in Army creatures controlled by the resolving player
one replacement-created black subtype Army token when no Army exists
state_reads: represented token and counter replacement descriptors
timing: additional-token replacements finish before the Army set is queried
counter placement finishes before the subtype addition and completion event
choices: the resolving player chooses one Army only when more than one current Army is legal
the affected controller orders competing represented token or counter replacements
apnap: replacement choices use the existing affected-player and affected-object controller ordering owners
layers: the added creature subtype is one locked layer-4 effect on the chosen battlefield incarnation
replacement_effects: token creation is independently replaceable before Army discovery
counter placement is independently replaceable before subtype addition
copy: the added subtype is a continuous effect and is not part of copiable values
copied or granted Amass instructions require separately trusted typed ability propagation
control_change: the offered Army set is controller-scoped and a stale choice fails closed
a committed subtype addition follows the same affected zone object through control changes
zone_change: an Army that leaves and returns is a new object and loses the old subtype effect and counters
source_leaves: the resolving stack object retains typed source provenance; the subtype result is bound to the affected Army rather than source lifetime

rulings: Wizards ruling — 2023-06-16 — With no Army, create the named 0/0 black Army first; then choose an Army, place counters, and add the subtype if needed.
Wizards ruling — 2023-06-16 — If more than one Army is controlled, no token is created and the player chooses which Army receives the counters.

implementation.component: quorune.amass, quorune.compiler.amass_templates, quorune.semantic_choices.amass, canonical token/counter transactions, and quorune.zone_object_subtype_grants

known_blockers: Amass X, zero, negative, repeated, conditional, optional, modal, copied, granted, and compound instructions remain outside the closed compiler family
linked references to the Army you amassed remain outside the current typed result vocabulary
unrepresented token creation, token prohibition, counter prevention, and continuous-effect interactions remain fail-closed
aggregate token, counter, replacement, layer, and keyword-action coverage remains incomplete
